goalbuddy_receipt_v1.summary: Implemented one fail-closed semantic adapter contract for Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and existing Pinterest variants. Ready classification now requires targetMatched=true, an exact enumerated ready route, and the route's exact native search-entry landmark. The acceptance harness accepts the QA protocol's top-level diagnostic projection, validates it against per-channel allowlists, preserves only bounded labels, permits entry preflight before results exist, and rejects authenticated screenshot capture. Playbooks and QA guidance allow one evidenced in-origin native Search navigation activation followed by the same bounded projection, with no guessed URL/selector, broader read, or second recovery. Fixtures cover ready, authenticated-shell, and target-unavailable variants, including the prior live failure shapes.
